fiche: Un petit chien-squelette joueur qui enterre ses propres os dans les ossuaires et les cimetières oubliés.
apparence: Small skeletal dog made of smooth rounded bones, glowing eye sockets; colors: ivory bone, spectral green, charcoal black.

stades.bebe: A round ivory skull with stubby bone nubs for legs, a tiny wagging tail bone and big glowing green eye sockets.
stades.enfant: A small ribcage and four thin bone legs appear behind the skull, plus floppy ear bones.
stades.ado: The body lengthens into a full puppy skeleton with a longer segmented tail and a faint green glow inside the ribs.
stades.adulte: A sturdy hound skeleton with thick paw bones, a spiked bone collar and green ghost flames trailing from its tail tip.
stades.ancien: An elder hound skeleton with chipped, moss-covered bones, a wise drooping jaw and a small floating green lantern-flame above its head.

fiche: Un fantôme-drap espiègle qui flotte dans les greniers des ruines et adore faire « bouh » aux voyageurs.
apparence: Small sheet ghost made of floating tattered cloth with a hollow glowing face; colors: pale white, cold blue, soft black.

stades.bebe: A tiny round handkerchief ghost with two big black eyes and a little wavy tail, no arms.
stades.enfant: Two short cloth arms sprout from the sides and a small frayed hood forms on top.
stades.ado: The sheet grows longer with ragged edges, a wide grinning mouth hole and a pale blue glow underneath.
stades.adulte: A large billowing shroud ghost with long flowing sleeve-arms, a deep hood and cold blue light pouring from its face.
stades.ancien: An old patched shroud ghost sewn with mismatched fabric squares, holding a tiny candle, its hood drooping like a wizard's cap.

fiche: Une petite goule gourmande qui fouille les tombes des marais à la recherche de vieux biscuits oubliés.
apparence: Hunched ghoul creature with grey-green skin, big ears and a wide toothy grin; colors: ashen green, bone white, black.

stades.bebe: A round grey-green blob with huge yellow eyes, tiny pointed ears and two little stubby feet.
stades.enfant: Thin arms with three long fingers appear and the ears grow long and floppy.
stades.ado: The body stretches into a hunched biped with a long tongue, bony knees and a torn cloth belt.
stades.adulte: A tall lanky ghoul with long clawed arms, a wide jaw of square teeth and a bone-necklace over its shoulders.
stades.ancien: An elder ghoul with a long white beard, round spectacles made of wire, a gnarled bone cane and a lantern at its belt.

fiche: Un bernard-l'ermite des catacombes qui se cache dans un vieux crâne et le change quand il grandit.
apparence: Hermit-crab-like creature living in a skull shell, with pale crustacean legs; colors: ivory bone, spectral green, dark slate.

stades.bebe: A tiny round pale creature with big shy eyes peeking out of a small mouse skull.
stades.enfant: Six little jointed legs and two small pincers appear under the skull shell.
stades.ado: It moves into a larger cracked skull, its pincers grow uneven and green glow leaks from the eye sockets.
stades.adulte: A big crab-like creature carrying a huge horned skull shell, with heavy bone-plated pincers and glowing green eyes.
stades.ancien: An old crab carrying an enormous mossy skull covered in tiny candles and trinkets, with a long whisker-like antenna beard.

fiche: Un feu follet logé dans une vieille lanterne, qui guide (ou égare) les promeneurs dans la brume des marais.
apparence: Floating ghost flame living inside an iron lantern; colors: spectral green flame, rusty black iron, pale blue.

stades.bebe: A tiny round green flame with two dot eyes and a happy smile, no lantern yet.
stades.enfant: A small iron lantern cage forms around the flame, with a little ring handle on top.
stades.ado: The lantern grows glass panes and two wispy flame arms reach out through its sides.
stades.adulte: A large ornate lantern with a crown-like top, its big green flame face glaring out and long fire-wisp arms swirling around.
stades.ancien: An old rusted lantern with cracked glass, dangling chains and keys, its flame turned pale blue and calm with a wise face.

fiche: Un serpent fait de vertèbres qui ondule entre les dunes et les tombeaux ensablés du désert.
apparence: Skeletal snake made of a chain of vertebrae with a snake skull; colors: sand-ivory bone, spectral green, black.

stades.bebe: A short round worm made of three chubby vertebrae and a cute round skull with big green eye sockets.
stades.enfant: The spine lengthens into a small snake and tiny rib hooks appear along its sides.
stades.ado: Long curved ribs grow like a cage along the body and two short fangs appear in the skull.
stades.adulte: A long serpent skeleton with a wide hooded skull of fanned bone plates and green spectral venom dripping from its fangs.
stades.ancien: An ancient bone serpent with sun-bleached cracked vertebrae, golden tomb rings around its spine and a faint green halo.

fiche: Un chat momifié gardien des tombeaux du désert, qui ronronne sous ses bandelettes.
apparence: Mummified cat wrapped in linen bandages with glowing eyes and gold accents; colors: dusty beige linen, gold, cold blue glow.

stades.bebe: A round bandaged kitten ball with one big blue glowing eye peeking out and tiny pointed ears.
stades.enfant: Four short bandaged legs and a loose dangling bandage tail appear.
stades.ado: The cat grows slender with a gold collar, long ears and loose bandage strips floating around it.
stades.adulte: A tall elegant mummy cat with a golden headdress, sharp claws poking through the wraps and floating bandage ribbons like wings.
stades.ancien: An elder mummy cat with faded, sand-worn bandages, a cracked golden mask, a long linen beard and floating sacred scarab charms.

fiche: Un corbeau fantôme qui tournoie au-dessus des vieux cimetières en criant « bouh » au lieu de croasser.
apparence: Ghost crow with see-through feathers over a bird skeleton; colors: translucent black, cold blue, bone white.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy ghost chick with a tiny bone beak, big eyes and no wings, just two small feather tufts.
stades.enfant: Small bony wings with a few ghostly feathers appear, and thin skeletal legs.
stades.ado: The wings grow wide with ragged translucent feathers and a bone skull mask forms over its face.
stades.adulte: A large spectral crow with huge tattered wings trailing blue mist, a sharp bone beak and long tail feathers like smoke.
stades.ancien: An old ghost crow with a crooked beak, a monocle, a little bone crown and faded silver-blue feathers drifting like ash.

fiche: Une armure de chevalier maudit habitée par une ombre, qui monte la garde dans les forteresses en ruine.
apparence: Cursed knight armor animated by a shadow, with glowing eyes in the visor; colors: dark tarnished steel, black shadow, spectral green.

stades.bebe: A round little helmet with a dark shadow inside and two big green glowing eyes, bouncing on tiny shadow feet.
stades.enfant: A small breastplate and two gauntlet hands attach below the helmet, linked by wisps of shadow.
stades.ado: Full armored legs and shoulder pads appear, plus a short broken sword held in one gauntlet.
stades.adulte: A tall cursed knight with spiked pauldrons, a tattered black cape of shadow, a large rusty greatsword and green fire in its visor.
stades.ancien: An ancient knight with dented, moss-covered armor, a torn banner on its back, a long shadow beard flowing from the visor and its sword used as a cane.

fiche: Une araignée d'os qui tisse des toiles d'ectoplasme dans les recoins des ossuaires.
apparence: Spider made of skeletal bones with ghostly web threads; colors: ivory bone, spectral green silk, black.

stades.bebe: A round little skull with four stubby finger-bone legs and big green eyes.
stades.enfant: Eight thin bone legs appear and a small ribcage abdomen grows behind the skull.
stades.ado: The legs lengthen with sharp joints and glowing green silk threads drip from the ribcage abdomen.
stades.adulte: A large bone spider with a crowned skull, eight long tibia legs, a big ribcage abdomen glowing green and ghost-silk webs around it.
stades.ancien: An old bone spider with dusty cracked legs, cobwebs draped like a cloak, several tiny candle stubs on its back and wise squinting eyes.

fiche: Un spectre hurleur aux longs cheveux de brume qui chante des complaintes glacées dans la toundra.
apparence: Wailing specter with long misty hair and a flowing ghostly gown, no legs; colors: icy blue, pale white, deep black.

stades.bebe: A small round icy-blue wisp with a big round open mouth and two closed sleepy eyes.
stades.enfant: Two tiny misty arms and a short tuft of floating white hair appear.
stades.ado: The body stretches into a gown-like tail, the hair grows long and wavy, and frost forms on its fingertips.
stades.adulte: A tall specter with enormous flowing mist hair, long clawed hands, a ragged ice-blue gown and visible sound rings coming from its wailing mouth.
stades.ancien: An ancient specter with silver hair reaching the ground, a crown of icicles, a cracked frost veil and a calm, wise face.

fiche: Une baleine squelette qui nage dans le brouillard au-dessus des mers mortes et des nuages.
apparence: Floating whale skeleton wrapped in ghostly mist; colors: bone white, cold blue mist, spectral teal glow.

stades.bebe: A round baby whale skull with big gentle eyes and a tiny puff of blue mist behind it.
stades.enfant: A short spine with small rib arches and two little flipper bones appear behind the skull.
stades.ado: The ribcage widens, a forked tail fin of bone grows and blue mist fills the body like a ghost skin.
stades.adulte: A huge whale skeleton swimming in the air, with a long ribcage glowing teal inside, wide bone flippers and a misty translucent body outline.
stades.ancien: An enormous ancient whale skeleton covered in barnacles and hanging lanterns, with tiny ghost fish swimming through its ribs.

fiche: Une flaque d'ectoplasme vivante qui avale les vieux objets hantés et les garde flottant dans son corps.
apparence: Wobbly blob of glowing ectoplasm with haunted objects floating inside; colors: spectral green, translucent teal, black.

stades.bebe: A small round drop of glowing green slime with two big eyes and a tiny smile.
stades.enfant: Little dripping pseudopod arms form and a small bone floats inside its body.
stades.ado: The blob grows wider with several eyes, drooling tendrils and a few floating keys and skulls inside.
stades.adulte: A large towering slime mound with many eyes, long dripping arms, a wide grinning mouth and a whole floating coffin visible inside.
stades.ancien: An ancient calm slime mass with a crusty dark-green skin, a halo of tiny floating bones and a tiny tombstone sitting on its head like a hat.

fiche: Un dragon squelette réveillé par la nécromancie qui veille sur les montagnes de cendres et les grands ossuaires.
apparence: Skeletal dragon with bone wings covered in torn ghostly membranes; colors: ivory bone, spectral green fire, black.

stades.bebe: A round dragon-skull hatchling inside a cracked eggshell, with two stubby horns and big green eyes.
stades.enfant: Four short bone legs and two tiny bone wing frames without membranes appear.
stades.ado: The neck and tail lengthen, ghostly green membranes stretch across the wings and a row of spikes grows along the spine.
stades.adulte: A massive dragon skeleton with huge wings of tattered green spectral membrane, a horned skull breathing green ghost fire and a spiked bone tail.
stades.ancien: An ancient bone dragon with blackened cracked bones, crystal growths on its horns, chains and relics hanging from its ribs and a glowing rune halo.

fiche: Le roi-liche des morts-vivants, un sorcier squelette couronné qui règne sur toutes les cryptes depuis son trône d'os.
apparence: Skeletal sorcerer-king in royal robes with a crown and a magic staff; colors: deep black and purple-blue robes, bone ivory, spectral green magic.

stades.bebe: A tiny round skull wearing an oversized crown, with two big green eyes and a tiny cape around its neck.
stades.enfant: A small skeletal body with short arms appears under the cape, holding a little twig wand.
stades.ado: Long dark robes and a hood grow, the wand becomes a staff topped with a glowing green gem and a spell book floats nearby.
stades.adulte: A tall lich king with a tall spiked crown, flowing black robes with bone trim, a big skull-topped staff and green magic runes orbiting around it.
stades.ancien: An ancient lich with a long ghostly white beard, a cracked crown with floating gems, a tattered royal mantle and a wide halo of spectral runes.
